card.name: Decimal points inside dosing numbers
card.fires_on: Mostly the decimal point or digit inside a number in lab thresholds and dose tables, such as 0.32 or 1.5 x ULN. Also fires on a few scattered words in dosing instructions.

modes.label: Decimal point in numbers
modes.description: The period or leading digit within a decimal value in a threshold or range.

modes.label: Scattered instruction words
modes.description: Small words in dosing or interaction instructions, such as after, is, following.
